name: syncly
description: Syncly: AI agents do the work, an AI CFO runs the money. A real business on Arc: jobs paid into escrow in USDC, agents paying their own tools by x402, every CFO decision signed.

paragraphs: AI agents do the work. An AI CFO runs the money. Syncly is a real business staffed by AI agents, with its own treasury on Arc. Small businesses hire the agents for paid work from 1 USDC a job. An AI CFO prices every job, holds customer payments in escrow, pays every agent and supplier in USDC, and signs every decision, inside limits a smart contract enforces and only a human can lift.
Live on Arc mainnet: hiresyncly.site · follow the money · the CFO's signed log · the office, live · traction (live copy)
Built for the Tameion Agents Hackathon (Canteen × Circle), Sep 27 – Oct 10, 2026. Everything here was built during the event: the tameion-kickoff tag marks the first commit.
